picks.name: The Procter & Gamble Company

picks.bear_case: Sales growth could slow; higher operating costs, commodity/FX pressures, competition and economic/geopolitical shocks can hurt results and the share price. P&G said the increase in net sales was partly offset by higher operating costs.
catalysts: Review the next official quarterly release and full-year guidance; the next earnings date could not be checked through the connected Twelve Data plan.
picks.sentiment_reason: Research conviction 65/100 = operating momentum 18/30 + business durability 23/25 + horizon/portfolio fit 17/25 + evidence/valuation completeness 7/20. Recent organic sales growth and cash-flow productivity support the case; EPS growth was only 1%. Valuation and broker checks are missing. This is a relative research score, not a profit probability or buy rating.

picks.name: PepsiCo, Inc.
picks.thesis: Consumer staples candidate that would diversify away from your direct MSFT/GOOGL positions. Q3 2026 net revenue increased 5.6%, organic revenue 3.1%, and core EPS 2%.

Dividends and share prices are not guaranteed.

catalysts: Review the next official quarterly release and guidance; the next earnings date could not be checked through the connected Twelve Data plan.
